description: User story under REQ-191 for the separation wiring (FBS-223): Hand: mixed with Separation-Reason:, rcf/separation.json, --require-hand, the Hand-Id trailer, and the pull_request CI step in this repository.
asA: the owner of a repository adopting the separation check
iWant: one recorded escape, a way to adjust classes that a builder cannot use, and the check running on every pull request
soThat: harness work can cross classes honestly and nothing merges without the line

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a commit carrying Hand: mixed and Separation-Reason: rename crosses test and src, touching src/ and test/, when rcf audit separation runs, then that commit passes, the line counts exceptions 1, and --json gives it verdict "exception" with the reason; Hand: mixed with an empty or absent Separation-Reason: fails exit 4 with reason "mixed without Separation-Reason".

[happy] Given rcf/separation.json { classes: { test: ["spec/**"] } }, when a Hand: builder commit touches spec/a.js, then the verb fails exit 4 naming spec/a.js; a malformed rcf/separation.json exits 2 naming the file; a Hand: builder commit that edits rcf/separation.json itself fails as a criteria-class touch.

[failure] Given --require-hand, when any non-merge commit in the range carries no Hand: trailer, or a Hand: builder commit carries no Hand-Id: trailer, then the verb exits 4 naming the commit and the missing trailer.

[happy] Given this repository's .github/workflows/ci.yml after the change, when a pull_request event runs CI, then a job with checkout fetch-depth 0 runs "node bin/rcf.js audit separation --base origin/${{ github.base_ref }}" from packages/rcf-lite and its exit code fails the job; the step does not run on push to main.

[must-not] a Separation-Reason: trailer that is empty or whitespace-only never turns Hand: mixed into a pass, and the CI step never runs with a shallow checkout (fetch-depth other than 0 makes the verb exit 2 naming the missing base).

title: The mixed escape, the class override file, --require-hand and CI on pull requests
